title: Find the subintervals
text: Here $$f(x)=x^2$$. The width of each subinterval is $$\frac{12-0}{6}=2$$. The midpoints of the subintervals are $$1$$, $$3$$, $$5$$, $$7$$, $$9$$ and $$11$$.

title: Apply the rule
text: Compute $$M_6=2\left(f{\left(1\right)}+f{\left(3\right)}+f{\left(5\right)}+f{\left(7\right)}+f{\left(9\right)}+f{\left(11\right)}\right)$$, which comes out to about $$572$$.
